market.question: Named storm forms before hurricane season?

assessment.reasoning: No pre-season Atlantic named storms have formed Dec 2025-Apr 2026, and the NHC doesn't begin issuing regular Tropical Weather Outlooks until May 15. Multiple seasonal forecasts (CSU, TSR) cite expected El Niño conditions and a slightly below-normal season, which suppresses early-season activity. With ~32 days remaining and El Niño headwinds, the probability is well below the recent decade base rate of ~30-40%. Market 0.385 is too high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a late-May subtropical low forms and gets named
